zeroing: CO2 FFI + CO2 AFOLU = 0 at timepoints >= 2030.5; all other species per marker
pulse: 100 GtC = 366.4058 GtCO2 into CO2 FFI at timepoint 2030.5
pulse_metric: d(airborne_emissions CO2)/pulse, annual mean of year 2030+h (timebounds Y, Y+1)
backgrounds: zero_bg = the zero arm (like-for-like with the excess); scenario_bg = the marker (the pulse lab's)
statistics: mean, median, p5, p95 across configs; ratio is per config, paired
seed: no RNG in this script; FaIR internal variability from the posterior's per-config seed column, identical in every arm
inputs: emissions spliced_ext_zenodo, forcing calibration_v160_prod/volcanic_solar_<M>.csv; G5 vs fair_v160_vv_pulse100.csv
